content.text: TODAYOURIST Pleased to Join the Southern Branch Group – The Z176 plant on the tour, resting and exploring the golden blue beauty at Nintendo – May there be plenty of excitement and meaning
Drifting into the wildest beauty of the Gulf of Hy – one of Vietnam's most beautiful bays
Relax at the Ning Beach with the blue water and the dream long sands
Exploration of the base vessel explores diverse marine ecosystems
Check-ins beautiful coastal roads with spectacular natural landscapes
Visiting the notable points of culture and features the South China Coast
Strengthening the Spirit of Unity, Communication, and Grouping
Enjoy fresh seafood with attractive local specials
Archive the memorable moments on an emotional rest journey
TODAYURIST honors the entire Board of Leaders and Staff, Southern Branch Officer – The Z176 plant is so healthy, so happy and has a safe, meaningful trip with so many fond memories!
